specs.Compact Design: The FHD(1920x1080) screen delivers clear visuals with an sRGB 99% (Typ.) color gamut and 250 nits brightness with 3000:1 contrast ratio.
specs.Dynamic Action Sync: By reducing input lag with Dynamic Action Sync, gamers can catch critical moments in real time and respond quickly.
specs.Black Stabilizer: The Black Stabilizer helps gamers detect snipers lurking in the darkest corners and swiftly navigate flash explosions.
specs.Reader Mode: The Reader Mode adjusts color temperature and luminance, supporting a suitable viewing experience for reading on a monitor.
specs.Flicker-safe: Being Flicker-safe reduces invisible flickering on the screen, providing a comfortable view.
